title: Petal project tracker
description: Petal project work and to-do contract. Regenerate with npm run build:validator.

status.description: Lifecycle name configured for the selected project. Completion rules are defined by project configuration.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within its file; never renumber during cleanup.

statusDetail.description: Explanatory status text only; no new lifecycle categories or suffixes in status.

statusAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone. Preserve historical timestamps during label normalization.

retestingSummary.description: Free-text retest summary. Replaces the misleading legacy retestingStatus field; it is not a second lifecycle status.

reportState.description: External issue state; distinct from tracker lifecycle status.

createdAt.description: When the row was opened. Immutable across status changes. Null only for legacy rows with no reliable creation date; do not substitute statusAt or a first-tracked commit date.

doneAt.description: Todo completion time, null until completed. Never invent a historical completion time.

est.description: Estimated time as written for a person, for example 45 min or 2h.

progress.description: Percentage done, 0-100. A done todo is 100; this records partial progress while it is still open.

row.description: Known fields retain their typed validation. Arbitrary extra properties may contain any JSON value and are displayed only in the row details sidebar, never added as table columns.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within its file; never renumber during cleanup.

category.description: Organizational category for the todo. Free-form so a new group never invalidates the file; todo.json uses category instead of the lifecycle status section used by bug/feature files.

createdAt.description: When the todo was opened. Immutable across completion changes. Null only for legacy rows with no reliable creation date.

done.description: Whether the todo is complete. The only state a todo has; there is no lifecycle status, statusAt or statusDetail.

doneAt.description: Completion time, null until done becomes true. Never invent a historical completion time.

est.description: Estimated time as written for a person, for example 45 min or 2h.

progress.description: Percentage done, 0-100. A done todo is 100; this records partial progress while it is still open.

todoItem.description: A to-do row: done or not done, with optional estimate, difficulty and progress. Known fields keep their types; arbitrary extra properties stay valid and are shown only in the sidebar.
